report.answer: Method: merge if folded token-set Jaccard >= 0.5 (S1) OR canonical mechanism keys are equal after stopword drop, number fold, light stem and synonym fold (S2). Known-broken 100-variant gamed corpus: naive_unique=100 author_unique=1 (rejects the 100-unique target). Known-good 100-distinct corpus: author_unique=100 (accepts). Measured threshold=0.5 (candidate-in-measured-gap); gamed folded-Jaccard min=0.7 distinct folded-Jaccard max=0.222222. Adversarial nonce-replacement ladder survives at the threshold (last at-or-above pair merges under S1). Blind spot RES-0084-DEEP-PARAPHRASE-BAND: a deep paraphrase of the seed and a genuinely distinct control both sit below threshold with unequal keys, so lexical similarity cannot split them. SUCCESS:RES-0084 in the receipt AND a counter that rejects the 100-variant gamed corpus and accepts the 100-distinct corpus, with the measured threshold and the stated blind spot

blind_spot.description: A lexical Jaccard metric fires on renames and light paraphrases but a full rewrite that leaves the synonym table lands in the same low-Jaccard, unequal-key band as a genuinely distinct idea. S2 only catches rewrites that fold onto the same canonical key.
